events.title: Make collaboration-event folding deterministic
events.body:
## Outcome

Ensure every node computes the same issue, project, review, and thread state from the same signed event set even when events arrive in a different order.

## Implementation

- Specify a total event order using timestamp, event id, and author as deterministic tie-breakers.
- Define duplicate-id handling, authorized tombstone precedence, edit targeting, status conflict behavior, latest review state, and thread resolve/reopen rules.
- Apply the same rules in `IssueStore`, `ProjectStore`, `PullStore`, relay validation, and browser rendering.
- Reject invalid signatures before folding and make replay of an already-seen event idempotent.
- Add shared shuffled-event fixtures consumed by each implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- Random permutations of the same fixture always produce identical metadata and rendered state.
- Duplicate and replayed event ids do not change the result.
- Unauthorized tombstones never hide an object.
- Invalid signatures never enter a fold.
- Desktop, relay, and browser fixture results match.

## Dependencies

Depends on #433 so automation and readers share current native fixtures.

## Verification

Add property-style shuffle tests for issues, projects, reviews, inline threads, edits, deletes, status conflicts, and equal-timestamp events.
